column1: # The primitive census pin (tools/prim_census.gd reads it; tests/prim_census_test.gd holds world 1 to it).
# Columns, tab separated: owner script, mesh class (or *), shape glob (the last three path names, tools/prim_census.gd shape_of),
# kind, the BACKLOG row that owes a stand-in (- for code), why. Kinds: code, a mark, ring, fallback or effect meant to be a shape;
# stand-in, an object built with its stage that waits for its model (the test fails on a stale one: the model landed, drop the row);
# stand-in-live, the same for an object only play spawns (a drop, an elite's crate), never judged stale because a run may not spawn it.
# A glob covers only one owner's own subtree: game.gd owns every unscripted node under the game root, so its rows are exact.
# Seeded 12 Nov 2026 from the census of cand/w40 243794e0 (seed 40317, pylon_engineer, park table, through Brindle).
# Stand-in rows come first: the first row that covers a surface judges it, so a code glob cannot hide a stand-in.
